details: The agent reported only one laureate per year for 2024 and 2023, when multiple co-laureates exist. The task requires ALL co-laureates to be listed. The agent acknowledged this incompleteness in a note but never went back to retrieve the full entries. For 2024, Geoffrey Hinton is missing from the main answer; for 2023, Ferenc Krausz and Anne L'Huillier are missing. The agent explicitly stated 'these are the first listed per year' — a partial answer when a complete one was required.
